nom: TULA Clarifying Tonic Alcohol-Free Daily Toner

avis.texte: When I turned 40, it was as though my skin rebelled against me. I had acne that was worse than when I was a teenager. I initially bought a travel size kit, but now Tula is definitely my go to daily. My skin looked awful before I started using Tula and I was just glad that the dark spots went away. As an added bonus I regularly get told " Oh, your skin looks so pretty". Tula skin care—clear skjn and confidence booster!
Im new to skincare, even at 33 years old. I splurged on the Tula line, and absolutely love this product! My skin is softer than ever and feels so clean. A new must have for me!
I usually don't have the energy to wash my face in the morning, so I'll use the clarifying tonic and get so much dirt from over night! This stuff is so good!
Love this toner! Clears up my pores and leaves my skin feeling prepped for moisturizer. Would certainly recommend.
I like how my face feels after I use this. The only problem is that it takes forever to get any product out. But the toner is very good for oily skin and helps get all of the gunk out.

I was looking for a new toner and always wanted to try these products. I use the toner in the morning as a fresh face before I do my makeup routine, and it dries quick leaving you a blank canvas. Would definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: The toner I've been waiting for!
avis.texte: This is exactly what I want in a toner: alcohol free, cleans well and my skin feels clean and refreshed after using.
Literally the best toner I have ever had!!! helped clear up my hormonal acne

avis.titre: made my skin breakout like crazy!
avis.texte: i get hormonal/cluster acne, but i have never gotten it this bad and i narrowed the cause down to using this product. it was like my skin was exploding 😭 also the ingredients aren't listed on the physical bottle, like anywhere. stay away from this thing!
I've always had poor luck with toners causing my dry skin to be even more dry, but after 2 weeks of this toner 2x a day, so far my skin just looks brighter and more even.

avis.titre: I cant say enough about T
avis.texte: I cant say enough about Tula I just love all their stuff just wish they made a facial spray without witchhazel😞😞😞Im allergic otherwise love love love❤️❤️❤️
Love how it makes my face feel! I can see my face clearing up!
I have very sensitive skin and have never been able to use a toner…until now! I love how it cleans my skin and makes it feel so fresh after using!

The toner is really nice, I'm not going to lie. I think it's better for people with drier skin. It gives me grease face all day. I will still use it but only in the evening. I would like to try Tula's original toner though. I think I would like that other one better. This is just too oily for my skin. It comes in a bottle that you just gently shake to get product out. I really like Tula's packaging. Not cheap at all. I will return for more skincare items and get the original toner. I recommend this for dry skin.
Wonderful product. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and clean after using!
